title: Skull Crusher
summary: Lying barbell or EZ-bar triceps extension: triceps 1, with the long head working at a long length (0.9).

equipment_needs.text: Needs: EZ curl bar or barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates; flat bench.

muscles.why: All three heads straighten the elbow. With the arm angled back over the head, the long head is lengthened, so it rates 0.9.

setup.text: Lie on a flat bench with an EZ bar over your chest.
Angle the arms slightly back toward your head.

form_cues.cue: Keep upper arms angled slightly back
form_cues.why: Lowering to the forehead or behind the head.

form_cues.cue: Bend the elbows to lower the bar behind your head
Lower behind the head for more stretch
form_cues.why: More shoulder flexion lengthens the long head.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Letting the elbows flare wide apart.
mistakes.fix: Lighten until the upper arms stay still.

misconceptions.myth: Every set has to go to failure to grow.
misconceptions.reality: Stopping a few reps short gave similar growth to failure in a meta-analysis; growth tends to rise as sets get closer to failure, but the exact curve is uncertain.

lower_risk.text: The app adds no ramp-up sets here. If the muscle is not warm from earlier work, make the first set a little lighter.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 2 reps in reserve in the 10-15 rep range. Stop a rep or two short; a missed rep is over your head.
Lower under control, and have a spotter or use dumbbells if pushing near failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Overhead: grew the long head more than pushdowns.
Cable pushdown: lower stretch, easy to push hard.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Bodyweight pressing with lots of triceps.

notes: Skull crushers have not been compared with other extensions for growth in a study the app cites.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
